title: BBMG Jidong Cement Group reports first-half results for 2026
summary: BBMG Jidong Cement Group reports first-half results for 2026
body_markdown: **China:** BBMG Jidong Cement Group reported US$1.43bn in sales in the first half of 2026, down by 18% year-on-year. Reuters News has reported that the producer recorded a net loss for the period of US$142m, up by a factor of six from US$22.9m in the first half of 2025.
